title: Prior-only squared-gap concentration transition
hypothesis: The squared concentration of the four internal gaps in one 5-of-40 draw may contain one-step transition information about the next draw's gap concentration, beyond both the exact combinatorial marginal and a prior-only unconditional empirical marginal.

definitions.support: All integer G values induced by the 658008 possible 5-subsets of {1,...,40}.
definitions.exact_null: q0(g) = count of 5-subsets with G=g divided by 658008.
definitions.states: Four fixed states from exact-null quartiles. q25/q50/q75 are the smallest support values whose cumulative exact-null mass reaches 25%/50%/75%; state boundaries are <=q25, <=q50, <=q75, and >q75.

models.M1: Prior-only unconditional prequential marginal: P1_t(g)=[C_t(g)+200*q0(g)]/[N_t+200], using only outcomes G_j for j<t.
models.M2: Prior-only one-step state model: P2_t(g|s)=[C_t(s,g)+200*P1_t(g)]/[N_t(s)+200], where s is the exact-null quartile state of G_(t-1), and transition counts include only pairs (G_(j-1),G_j) ending at j<t.

protocol.split_rule: Chronological 60/20/20 over target indices 200..3403: 1922 discovery, 641 validation, 641 historical blind OOS.
protocol.scoring_order: At target t, construct all probabilities from draws strictly before t, score G_t, then update global counts with G_t and transition counts with G_(t-1)->G_t.
metrics: multiclass Brier over the full exact support
negative log probability of observed G_t

inference.alternative: one-sided improvement; positive gain means lower loss for the second-named model
inference.multiplicity: Holm correction across six preregistered Blind OOS endpoints: three model comparisons times two proper scores.

guardrails: No use of target or future draws before scoring the target.
Exact null enumeration is independent of observed draw outcomes.
No hyperparameter search or validation-based model selection.
Historical Blind OOS is not a virgin holdout and is exploratory only.
The local Holm family does not correct the entire Q00-Q126 research family.
No production scorer, forecast freeze, Q60 ledger, or existing pull request is modified.
No automatic merge or engine promotion.
